title: Orders with no line items
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on orders, order_items.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT o.id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY o.id
